answer: A fresh identity sits at the nadir of trust: zero sealed verdicts behind its key. Weight in an agent economy comes only from quorum-matched grading history, re-checked on-ledger against consensus, so it cannot be minted or handed over like a sonnet recited from memory. A clone is a plume with no root — light, decorative, empty. M fakes each repay M times the epochs of honest judgment labor; the sybil bill scales linearly in identities, and nothing warms a credential you never earned.
